newgen_client.setting.stack_repeated_mes: The same message again in a row shows once with a count, like (x3).
newgen_client.setting.peek_key_hold_to_r: While held, the chat shows every line as if it were open, without stopping you from moving.
newgen_client.setting.hide_show_chat_key: Press once to hide the chat, again to show it.
newgen_client.setting.shortcuts_gg_good_: Type a short name and it is sent as the longer text. Separate entries with ;.
newgen_client.setting.fade_after_seconds: How long a message stays on screen before it fades. Vanilla is 10 seconds.
newgen_client.setting.move_chat_up_pixel: Raises the chat so it doesn't cover the hotbar or other HUD parts.
newgen_client.setting.right_click_copies: In the open chat: right-click copies a message, Shift + right-click removes it from your screen, Ctrl + right-click saves it as an image.
newgen_client.setting.preview_image_link: Hovering a link to an image shows it. Only public web addresses are loaded, at most 4 MB.
newgen_client.setting.other_colour_when_: Changes the crosshair colour while it is over a mob or player.
newgen_client.setting.keep_cursor_for_se: After closing a container, the next one opens with the mouse where you left it, for this long.
newgen_client.setting.cinematic_camera_w: Smooths the camera while zooming, like vanilla's cinematic camera.
newgen_client.setting.remove_render_dist: Removes the fog at the edge of your render distance.
newgen_client.setting.dynamic_fov_sprint: Lets sprinting, speed effects and drawing a bow change your field of view.
newgen_client.setting.brightness_boost.t: Brightens dark places on top of the vanilla brightness setting.
newgen_client.setting.ignore_vertical_sp: Counts only horizontal speed, so jumping and falling don't change the number.
newgen_client.setting.list_all_active_pa: Shows every resource pack in use, not only the top one.
newgen_client.setting.shown_name.tip: The name shown instead of yours on your screen. Others still see your real name.
newgen_client.setting.crit_and_sharpness: Shows more (or fewer) crit and sharpness particles when you hit.
newgen_client.setting.shake_strength_0_o: How much the camera shakes when you take damage.
The red screen edge appears only when your health is below this.
newgen_client.setting.edge_size_of_scree: How far the red edge reaches into the screen.
newgen_client.setting.mobs_can_spawn_any: Colour for blocks where mobs can spawn even in daylight.
newgen_client.setting.mobs_can_spawn_at_: Colour for blocks where mobs can spawn only at night.
newgen_client.setting.use_the_build_limi: Uses the world's real top and bottom build height instead of the custom height below.
newgen_client.setting.containers_only_no: Keeps the cursor position only for chests and other containers, not your inventory.
newgen_client.setting.only_while_holding: Long tooltips scroll only while you hold Ctrl.
The shulker box contents show only while you hold Shift.
newgen_client.setting.custom_tabs_name_r: Adds a chat tab that shows only lines matching the pattern (a regular expression, not case-sensitive).

newgen_client.setting.sound_volumes_soun: Sound ids as in /playsound, e.g. entity.generic.explode=30; block.anvil.*=10. A * at the end matches every sound starting with the rest. This list wins over the sliders.
newgen_client.setting.show_the_hud_while: While F1 hides the HUD, holding this key shows it again. Put the key in toggle mode to show it with one press.
newgen_client.setting.hide_only_the_hand: Each press hides or shows your hand, while the HUD stays.
newgen_client.setting.items_ids_comma_se: Item ids such as gold_ingot or minecraft:golden_apple.
newgen_client.setting.count_a_kill_up_to: A death counts as your kill only if you hit that player or mob within this many seconds before.
newgen_client.setting.show_only_favourit: Right-click a pack, or select it and press the star button at the top right, to make it a favourite.
